video:video.video:description: A Russian missile barrage overnight Thursday killed at least 12 people in Kyiv as explosions echoed across the capital throughout the night, local authorities said.

video:video.video:title: Old sunken steamboat revealed in Serbia due to low river levels
video:video.video:description: A historic steam tugboat known as The Slovenian has emerged from the Sava River near Sremska Mitrovica, Serbia, as prolonged heat and drought cause Europe's rivers to reach record-low levels (AP video shot by: Marko Drobnjakovic).
